description: Evaluation set for ReAct + Reflexion homework. Each question requires 2-4 reasoning steps using wikipedia_search and/or calculator. Ground-truth answers are exact strings or numbers; use a tolerant string-match (case-insensitive, ignore trailing punctuation) when grading.

questions.question: In what year was the author of 'Pride and Prejudice' born? Multiply that year by 2.
How many years passed between the founding of the Roman Empire (27 BC) and the fall of Constantinople (1453 AD)?
questions.hint_for_grader: 27 + 1453 = 1480 (no year zero, but for this task simple arithmetic is accepted).

questions.question: In what year was Leonardo da Vinci born? Add 500 to that year.
Albert Einstein received the Nobel Prize in Physics in a certain year. What is the square root of that year, rounded to two decimal places?
How many sides does a dodecagon have? Raise that number to the power of 3.
In what year did the first human walk on the Moon? How many years ago was that, counting from the year 2025?
Marie Curie won two Nobel Prizes. In what year did she win her second one? Subtract the year of her first Nobel Prize from her second.
questions.hint_for_grader: First in Physics 1903, second in Chemistry 1911. 1911 - 1903 = 8.

questions.question: What is the speed of light in vacuum, in meters per second? Divide it by 1000 and round to the nearest integer.
How many planets are in our Solar System (excluding Pluto)? Multiply that number by the number of moons of Earth.
What year was the Eiffel Tower completed? Compute that year modulo 100.
